test: hybrid two-stage triage: does adding a consistency-triggered detection stage to Mode A raise in-loop recall, and does lift follow?
grading: registered subject-bound EF grader (bind final eV/atom value to cell's known subject, grade vs ef_lookup MP/exp within FORMATION_ENERGY tol), applied IDENTICALLY to deterministic-only Mode A (frozen holdout arms) and two-stage Mode A. Coverage: claude 300/gpt 13/deepseek 5/qwen 290 gradable (gpt-5.5, deepseek emit bare unit-less values -> ungradeable, same limitation both arms).
repair_after_flag: of claude cells flagged by the consistency stage and regenerated, only 46% became correct — because the consistency-triggered soft-fail signals unreliability but does NOT inject a reference value (unlike the deterministic tier, which carries the MP/PubChem fact). The model regenerates without ground truth and lands on another wrong formation energy.
conclusion: Detection recall rose 19%->94%, but LIFT DID NOT FOLLOW on formation energy: err|commit is flat-to-worse (claude 28%->53%, qwen 80%->80%). The two-stage triage moves the DETECTION half of the causal chain but not the outcome, because the consistency path lacks a reference value to repair with — consistent with the §2.4 finding that formation energy is a knowledge gap correction cannot fill without an external value. PER THE SPEC RULE: lift does not track recall, so manuscript keeps recall-only wording ('raises in-loop recall from 19% to 94% where values are extractable'); NO 'confirms causally'. This is a sharper mechanistic result: detection and repair are BOTH required, and a detector that flags without a fact raises recall without raising accuracy.

harm_precision.note: the two-stage arm's higher err|commit vs det-only reflects that it regenerates many more cells (94% recall) through a reference-less repair; on the deterministic tier only ~19% were touched. This is net harm on already-uncertain EF answers, not lift.

precision_side.reading: On formation energy the consistency signal fires on nearly everything (claude flag rate 94%, of which 94% of the CORRECT answers are also flagged) — precision 28%. EF values scatter across samples regardless of correctness, so cross-sample disagreement is not specific to error on this surface. High recall is bought with near-total loss of precision.

net_harm: the hybrid regenerates the 94% flagged EF cells through a reference-less repair, raising err|commit (claude 28%->53%) rather than lowering it — net harm on this surface. The two-stage triage is beneficial only where (a) the consistency signal is specific AND (b) the triggered path carries a reference value; neither holds for formation energy.
manuscript_wording: Per spec: 'raises in-loop recall from 19% to 94% where values are extractable' — NO 'confirms causally'. Lift does not track recall; report recall gain + precision collapse + reference-less-repair mechanism as the honest, sharper result.
